title: Mizzen source map
description: /sourcemap.json at the site root: which source file, and which range in it, produced each built page, section, link, and trust or drift claim. Version 0 is a draft; see spec/sourcemap/v0.md. A url must not appear twice, which JSON Schema cannot express; tools/theme/sourcemap.ts checks it.

column.description: 1-based column in the source file, counting Unicode code points; a tab is one column.

line.description: 1-based line in the source file, front matter included.

claims.description: Trust and drift evidence claims in document order.

source.description: The source file, relative to the site source folder, with forward slashes.

url.description: The page's URL path from the site root, as the generator writes it (`/docs/intro.html` or `/docs/intro/`).

column.description: 1-based column where the heading starts. Absent at the level-0 and level-1 maps.

endColumn.description: Column of the heading's last character (inclusive). Absent when the map has no end.

endLine.description: 1-based line where the heading ends; the same as `line` for a one-line heading. Absent when the map has no end.

id.description: The heading's id in the built HTML.

target.description: The code range a drift claim cites, exactly as the page writes it. It is never adjusted; whether the code still holds is the drift check's finding.

column.description: The cited column. Absent when the page names only lines.

endLine.description: The last cited line of a range. Absent when the page names one line.

file.description: The cited file, relative to the repository root, with forward slashes.

column.description: 1-based column where the link starts. Absent at the level-0 and level-1 maps.

endColumn.description: Column of the link's last character (inclusive). Absent when the map has no end.

endLine.description: 1-based line where the link ends; the same as `line` for a one-line link. Absent when the map has no end.

href.description: The link target as written in the source.

claim.description: One piece of evidence behind a page's trust or drift signals, with its exact span in the page's own source file.

trustClaim.description: A runnable example (`test` fence): the trust evidence of the page, with the fence's exact span in the page's own source file (the page's `source`).

endColumn.description: Column of the claim's last character (inclusive).

example.description: The runnable example's id, as `examples.json` and the theme use it.

driftClaim.description: A `path:line` code reference: the drift evidence of the page, with the reference's exact span in the page's own source file (the page's `source`) and the target range it cites.

endColumn.description: Column of the claim's last character (inclusive).

reference.description: The citation as `drift.json` writes it, such as `src/app.ts:12`.

target.description: The file and range the page points at.
